title: Merge Tower Defense
description: Summon elemental turrets and merge matching tiers right on the winding battlefield to melt escalating enemy waves with laser, frost, and cannon fire.
controls: Tap to buy new turrets and drag identical levels together to merge stronger towers along the enemy path.

zh-CN.title: 合成塔防大师
zh-CN.description: 魔性上头放置策略合成塔防大师：召唤炮塔两两合成秒升神装，激光寒冰重炮齐发守住蜿蜒防线！
zh-CN.controls: 点击购买防御塔并将两座同级炮塔拖到一起合成升级，消灭沿路进攻的怪物。
